title: Data Platform Engineer
overview:
Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

About the Role

We are looking for a Data Platform Engineer to help build and operate Atlassian's foundational data platform, growing rapidly on high-scale distributed data systems with real ownership.

Our platform powers the data behind critical experiences across the company—from rich in-product analytics in Jira, JSM, and Confluence, to dedicated solutions like Atlassian Analytics, the Teamwork Graph (TWG), and AI-native capabilities like Rovo. In this role, the components you build will directly shape how hundreds of thousands of organizations explore, understand, and act on their data.

We seek individuals who are eager to shape the future and believe in the power of collaboration to achieve extraordinary results together.
responsibilities:
• Build and operate components of Atlassian's data platform across streaming ingestion (Flink) and MPP query/serving (StarRocks), alongside senior engineers.

  • Contribute high-quality code from design through delivery, taking ownership of features and bug fixes.

  • Participate in operating high-scale data platform systems in production—on-call, debugging, and basic performance and data-quality tuning.

  • Participate in code reviews and write clear documentation.

  • Collaborate with your team and partner teams to deliver reliable, performant data infrastructure.

  • Continuously learn and grow your depth in distributed data systems.
qualifications:
• 3+ years in software engineering with solid distributed-systems / data fundamentals.

  • Exposure to / experience with data platform systems — streaming/ingestion (Flink) and/or MPP query engines (StarRocks / Trino / Apache Pinot / Apache Doris/ Druid).

  • Some experience or strong aptitude for operational management of high-scale data platform systems (participating in on-call, debugging production, performance/data-quality basics).

  • Strong coding (Java/Scala/Python) and familiarity with cloud data infrastructure (GCP/AWS).

  • Open-source contributions to relevant projects are a strong positive.

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh.

responsibilities:
SMB Account Executives play a crucial role in guiding customers through their Atlassian cloud journey. The primary objective is to demonstrate to SMB customers how Atlassian products can effectively support their objectives. Operating at scale, Sales Associates are expected to advocate for their customers, offering valuable insights to our product and engineering teams to enhance the customer experience. This collaborative effort is closely coordinated with our Product specialists and Marketing organization.

SMB AE’s are known for their customer-centric approach and innovative thinking. They are adept at managing resources efficiently to cater to the requirements of our top 30,000 SMB customers.

You will directly report to the Sales Manager within your geographical region. This position is remote, offering flexibility and autonomy.

What You'll Do:

  • Follow up on qualified inbound leads (MQLs, trial signups, demo requests) and drive outbound prospecting to generate new and expansion pipeline for SMB accounts.

  • Qualify customers’ needs and pain points through a consultative sales approach, building strong strategic relationships.

  • Demonstrate the value and ROI of Atlassian products, assisting customers in building compelling business cases to drive adoption and upsell opportunities.

  • Develop and execute territory account plans to meet or exceed quota, maximizing revenue growth and customer success across a broad portfolio.

  • Stay current on industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activities to inform strategy and customer conversations.
qualifications:
Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in outbound sales in a quota-carrying B2B software sales role

  • Proven track record of exceeding performance targets

  • Building and leading territory & strategic account plans

  • Proficiency in using sales tools such as CRM software (e.g., Salesforce) and prospecting tools

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapting to changing priorities.

  • You have a do-it-right mentality with a customer-centric mindset.
